entry.title: GWAS Related Useful Resources
entry.content:
GWAS Tutorial

  • GWASLab
  • GWAS Tutorial

This tutorial is provided by the Laboratory of Complex Trait Genomics (Kamatani Lab) in the Department of Computational Biology and Medical Sciences at the University of Tokyo. This tutorial is designed for the graduate course Basic Seminar II.

This repository is currently maintained by Yunye He.
entry.summary: A collection of useful and interesting GWAS-related resources.
